correctness.rationale: The completed-square identity in RESULT.md holds exactly for every real input. Compactness of strict sublevels settles the attained regime; positivity of the numerator together with an explicit diverging trial path settles nonattainment. Every ridge minimizer approaches the nonattaining branch, giving matching lower and upper bounds from inverse-square and inverse-fourth-power tails in the respective regimes. Their rescaled energies have unique global minimizers. The checker verifies exact symbolic identities and representative finite computations; the asymptotic conclusions come from the proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: The smallest realistic overdetermined two-variable, one-penalty rank-deficient TLS model already has a sharp correlation-induced nonattainment transition. Vanishing full-rank regularization can force parameter estimates to diverge with distinct fourth- versus sixth-root exponents; exact constants inform regularization scale selection. The threshold compares two data instances not separated by the common strict sufficient attainment test. This is a natural sensitivity classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
